items.title: Can Medtronic (MDT) Still Justify Its Price On Cash Flow?
items.summary: Medtronic has delivered a 58.9% share price gain over the past three years, and the real question now is whether that kind of run is still supported by the cash the business can generate. With fresh clinical data, updated product labeling and new educational partnerships in the spotlight, the stock invites a closer look at how its current price lines up against an intrinsic value estimate built on its cash flows.
